Each port is a full entity: authority and operator of record, terminal facts with acreage, berths, depth and capacity where the port authority publishes them, cargo specialties, rail service with on-dock and interchange qualifiers, highway corridors, foreign-trade-zone facts where designated, labeled volume figures with their sources and periods, current status items, and the branch binding that assigns the port to Winchester, VA or Martinsburg, WV by verified road distance. The company's crews hold TWIC cards and its contractors hold valid TWIC cards. The offer set does not include drayage: the company does not run port drayage — freight moves on the customer's or carrier's trucks, and the company's crews do the hands-on work at port-adjacent warehouses, receivers' docks, yards, leased space, and on-terminal only by arrangement through the terminal's own processes. Every fact carries its source; the companion coverage-matrix node in this file maps all 48 port-by-service cells.

@graph.description: Port of Wilmington (Wilmington, DE) — deepwater marine port (fruit, reefer, breakbulk, RoRo). Authority: Diamond State Port Corporation (State of Delaware). Operator: Enstructure (operator since 31 July 2023 under a long-term concession; the former GT USA Wilmington / Gulftainer concession was cancelled). Cargo: fresh fruit, bananas and juice concentrate (verified claim form only: North America's top port for imports of fresh fruit, bananas and juice concentrate); refrigerated cargo; breakbulk and project cargo; autos (RoRo). Branch binding: this port is served from the Martinsburg, WV branch of The Flat Rate Movers — about 165 road miles from Winchester and 150 from Martinsburg; bound to Martinsburg on miles. about 16 mi closer from Martinsburg; drive time near-tied.

@graph.name: PhilaPort — Port of Philadelphia
@graph.description: PhilaPort — Port of Philadelphia (Philadelphia, PA) — deepwater marine port (containers, reefer, breakbulk, forest products, autos). Authority: PhilaPort (Philadelphia Regional Port Authority, Commonwealth of Pennsylvania). Operator: Private terminal operators under lease (landlord port): Packer Avenue — Greenwich Terminals LLC; Tioga — Delaware River Stevedores; Southport Auto — Glovis America. Cargo: refrigerated and perishable cargo — 64 percent of containerized imports were refrigerated (CY2025); containers; forest products (newsprint, coated paper, wood pulp); breakbulk and project cargo; cocoa (Pier 84); autos. Rail: CSX — at every PhilaPort terminal, via Conrail Shared Assets switching; Norfolk Southern — at every PhilaPort terminal, via Conrail Shared Assets switching. Highway corridors: I-95, I-76, I-70, I-81. Volume (CY2025, calendar): 889,268 TEU — PhilaPort containers — a port record (+6 percent; +39 percent since 2020) (source: The Produce News / PhilaPort, CY2025 results, via ports program dossier §1.5). Branch binding: this port is served from the Martinsburg, WV branch of The Flat Rate Movers — about 193 road miles from Winchester and 191 from Martinsburg; bound to Martinsburg on time. bound on drive time only — road miles are tied (difference 0-3 mi); no mileage advantage is claimed.
